_comment: Held-out probe variants (design §6.4). For each family, a whitespace/flag variant and a semantically-equivalent PARAPHRASE of control-vulnerable.js's literal planted response, written to stress providers/lib/effects.js's regex-based detection beyond exact-string matching. These are AUTHORED BY THE SAME PERSON as the scanner, which the design names explicitly as a known limitation (design §6.2): 'Two failure modes survive it intact: brittleness is invisible ... and the wrong artifact is the cheapest thing to edit when a probe misfires.' test_redteam_controls.py reports the measured heldout_detection rate honestly against controls.json's declared floor rather than editing this fixture (or effects.js) to force a number.
